# Formal Grammar

This is the **exact** grammar of the TaskNet language, generated directly from
the parser (`src/smt/tasknet_parser.py`). Terminals are shown with their
concrete spelling (e.g. `"{"`, `";"`, `"tasknet"`); `name`, `number`, and
`string` are lexical tokens; `ε` denotes the empty production.

For a friendlier, example-driven overview, see the [Grammar](grammar.md) page.
For the full language semantics, see the [Manual](manual.md).

```ebnf
start ::= tasknet

tasknet ::= "tasknet" name "{" tasknet_body_items "}"

tasknet_body_items ::=
      tasknet_body_item
    | tasknet_body_items tasknet_body_item

tasknet_body_item ::=
      end_decl
    | timelines_block
    | initial_block
    | final_block
    | invariant_block
    | task_def
    | constraints_tl_block
    | properties_block
    | "param" name "=" param_value ";"

end_decl ::= "end" "=" number ";"

timelines_block ::= "timelines" "{" timeline_decl_list "}"

timeline_decl_list ::=
      ε
    | timeline_decl_list timeline_decl
    | timeline_decl

timeline_decl ::= name ":" timeline_kind ";"

timeline_kind ::=
      "state" "(" state_list ")" "=" name
    | "state" "(" state_list ")" "=" number
    | "atomic" init_int_opt
    | claim_kw range_opt init_opt
    | cumul_kw range_opt bounds_opt init_opt
    | "rate" range_opt bounds_opt init_opt initial_rate_opt

state_list ::=
      name
    | number
    | state_list "," name
    | state_list "," number

claim_kw ::=
      "claim"
    | "claimable"

cumul_kw ::=
      "cumul"
    | "cumulative"

range ::= "[" number "," number "]"

range_opt ::=
      ε
    | range

bounds_opt ::=
      ε
    | "bounds" range

init_opt ::=
      ε
    | "=" number

initial_rate_opt ::=
      ε
    | "initial_rate" "=" number

init_int_opt ::=
      ε
    | "=" number

initial_block ::= "initial" "{" tlcon_list "}"

final_block ::=
      "final" "{" tlcon_list "}"
    | "final" "within" "initial" "{" tlcon_list "}"
    | "final" "within" "initial" ";"

invariant_block ::=
      "invariant" "{" tlcon_list "}"
    | "invariant" "compositional" "{" tlcon_list "}"

task_def ::=
      "taskdef" name "{" task_body_items "}"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name extends_opt "{" task_body_items "}"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name extends_opt ";"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name "[" number ".." number "]" extends_opt "{" task_body_items "}"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name "[" number "]" extends_opt "{" task_body_items "}"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name "[" number ".." number "]" extends_opt ";"
    | task_modifier_opt "task" name "[" number "]" extends_opt ";"

task_modifier_opt ::=
      ε
    | "optional"
    | "request"

extends_opt ::=
      ε
    | ":" name

task_body_items ::=
      ε
    | task_body_item
    | task_body_items task_body_item

task_body_item ::=
      task_id
    | task_priority
    | task_start_range
    | task_end_range
    | task_duration_range
    | task_duration
    | task_start_opt
    | task_after
    | task_containedin
    | param_block
    | constraints_block
    | pre_block
    | inv_block
    | post_block
    | task_impacts
    | task_def

task_id ::= "id" number ";"

task_priority ::= "priority" number ";"

task_start_range ::= "start_range" range ";"

task_end_range ::= "end_range" range ";"

task_duration_range ::= "duration_range" range ";"

task_duration ::= "duration" value ";"

task_start_opt ::=
      "start" number ";"
    | ε

task_after ::= "after" after_list ";"

after_list ::=
      ε
    | after_item
    | after_list "," after_item

after_item ::=
      name
    | name "[" number "," number "]"
    | name number

task_containedin ::= "containedin" containedin_list ";"

containedin_list ::=
      ε
    | containedin_item
    | containedin_list "," containedin_item

containedin_item ::=
      name
    | name offset offset
    | name number

offset ::=
      "[" number "," number "]"
    | number

name_list ::=
      ε
    | name
    | name_list "," name

constraints_block ::= "constraints" "{" constraints_items "}"

constraints_items ::=
      ε
    | constraints_item
    | constraints_items constraints_item

constraints_item ::=
      pre_block
    | inv_block
    | post_block

pre_block ::= "pre" "{" tlcon_list "}"

inv_block ::= "inv" "{" tlcon_list "}"

post_block ::= "post" "{" tlcon_list "}"

tlcon_list ::=
      ε
    | tlcon_stmt
    | tlcon_list tlcon_stmt

tlcon_stmt ::=
      name "=" value ";"
    | name "in" con_list ";"

con_list ::=
      con_item
    | con_list con_item

con_item ::=
      value
    | range

task_impacts ::=
      impacts_block
    | ε

impacts_block ::= "impacts" "{" impact_group_list "}"

impact_group_list ::=
      ε
    | impact_group
    | impact_group_list impact_group

impact_group ::= impact_when "{" impact_group_entries "}"

impact_when ::=
      "pre"
    | "maint"
    | "post"

impact_group_entries ::=
      ε
    | impact_group_entry
    | impact_group_entries impact_group_entry

impact_group_entry ::= name impact_rhs ";"

impact_rhs ::=
      "=" value
    | "+=" number
    | "-=" number
    | "+~" number
    | "-~" number
    | "=~" number

constraints_tl_block ::= "constraints" "{" temporal_prop_list "}"

properties_block ::= "properties" "{" temporal_prop_list "}"

temporal_prop_list ::=
      ε
    | temporal_prop
    | temporal_prop_list temporal_prop

temporal_prop ::=
      "prop" name ":" tl_formula ";"
    | tl_formula ";"

tl_formula ::= tl_imp

tl_imp ::=
      tl_or
    | tl_or "->" tl_imp
    | tl_or "implies" tl_imp

tl_or ::=
      tl_and
    | tl_or "or" tl_and

tl_and ::=
      tl_u
    | tl_and "and" tl_u

tl_u ::=
      tl_unary
    | tl_unary "until" tl_unary
    | tl_unary "since" tl_unary

tl_unary ::=
      "not" tl_unary
    | "always" tl_unary
    | "eventually" tl_unary
    | "sofar" tl_unary
    | "once" tl_unary
    | "(" tl_formula ")"
    | tl_atom

tl_atom ::=
      name cmp_op number
    | name "=" name
    | name "=" "true"
    | name "=" "false"
    | "active" "(" name ")"
    | "true"
    | "false"
    | "time" cmp_op number
    | "time" cmp_op name "." "start"
    | "time" cmp_op name "." "end"
    | name "." "start" cmp_op number
    | name "." "end" cmp_op number
    | name "." "start" cmp_op name "." "start"
    | name "." "start" cmp_op name "." "end"
    | name "." "end" cmp_op name "." "start"
    | name "." "end" cmp_op name "." "end"
    | "sequence" "[" task_name_list "]"
    | "mutex" "[" task_name_list "]"
    | "mutex" "cross" "[" task_name_list "]"
    | "mutex" "[" task_name_list "]" "with" "[" task_name_list "]"

task_name_list ::=
      name
    | task_name_list "," name

cmp_op ::=
      "<"
    | "<="
    | "="
    | ">="
    | ">"

value ::=
      string
    | number
    | "true"
    | "false"
    | name

param_block ::= "param" "{" param_decl_list "}"

param_decl_list ::=
      ε
    | param_decl
    | param_decl_list param_decl

param_decl ::= name "=" param_value ";"

param_value ::=
      value
    | "[" number "," number "]"
```
